title: Ronil Goa, part of Hyatt
description: Ronil Goa is a boutique resort with 135 chic rooms and suites spread across twelve guest houses. Its design reflects Goan textures—with fluted wall panels, minimalistic décor, balconies, and complimentary minibars in many rooms

title: Hotel Ocean Wave, Calangute Beach
description: Hotel Ocean Wave is a newly renovated 3‑star property located in the heart of Calangute, just a short walk from Calangute Beach (410 m) and close to Baga and Candolim beaches. It is highly rated for cleanliness, staff behavior, and value for money

title: Bloom Boutique Baga
description: Bloom Boutique | Baga is a modern, stylish boutique hotel located in the lively Baga–Arpora area of North Goa. It offers a blend of comfort, design, and convenience, ideal for travelers who want to stay near Baga Beach and Goa’s vibrant nightlife.

title: Ginger Goa, Candolim
description: Ginger Goa, Candolim is a newly built (2024) modern hotel designed for comfort, convenience, and a stylish Goan getaway. Located in the heart of Candolim, it offers close proximity to beaches, markets, and major attractions.

title: Lotus Sutra Beachfront Resort
description: Lotus Sutra Beachside Abode is a beachfront resort located directly on Arambol Beach, offering cozy wooden cottages, sea‑view rooms, and a peaceful tropical ambience. It is ideal for travelers who want a calm, scenic, nature‑driven stay with immediate beach access.

title: Red Thread Calangute
description: Red Thread Calangute is a stylish, boutique‑style hotel located in the heart of Calangute, near Dolphin Circle. It’s known for its classy interiors, premium ambiance, cleanliness, and exceptional staff service.

title: Holiday Inn Goa Candolim
description:
Welcome to Holiday Inn Resort, your Mediterranean-inspired retreat located at Mobor Beach, Cavelossim, in South Goa. Enjoy direct access to the enchanting Arabian Sea, offering a unique and unforgettable experience.

Conveniently located 38km from Dabolim International Airport and 17km from Margao Railway Station, our resort provides an ideal setting for a relaxing and fun-filled vacation in Goa. Our spacious rooms, each with a balcony, offer breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea and beautifully landscaped gardens.

Holiday Inn Resort features versatile indoor and outdoor venues perfect for meetings, events, and destination weddings. Our Ballroom, one of Goa’s largest pillar-less banquet halls at 5,068 sq ft, along with 1,26,000 sq ft of flexible lawn space, creates the perfect backdrop for romantic weddings.

title: Crowne Plaza
description: Welcome to Crowne Plaza Today Gurugram, a premier business hotel located in the heart of central business district. Located near leading MNCs like Google, McKinsey, PwC, and Accenture, the hotel blends a combination of business and leisure with the comfort of luxury.
